title: Versioned q0-screen recovery

trigger.stopped_after: six frozen training runs and 24 fresh-bank q0 trajectories
trigger.implementation_error: The R292 adapter reused audit_zero_support_screen_record, which requires zero_support identity, zero BESS power, constant SOC, and M_es=200, although the frozen R292 q0 arm uses controller q0, active droop-PI BESS, and M_es=350 during its 15-step pulse before returning to 200.

authorized_recovery.screen_audit: Validate q0 identity, 300-step completion, 60-Hz schema, frozen 15-step common-inertia timing, zero edge/node residual, D=0, BESS/SOC bounds, saturation/constraint status, finite values, and trace hash without evaluating frequency performance.
authorized_recovery.screen_reuse: Verify the original seal, candidate bank, provenance, and all 24 trace hashes, then re-audit those immutable raw traces into versioned outputs with zero ANDES runs and zero scenario redraws.

formal_matrix.arms: q0 plus three centralized-vector seeds plus three distributed-edge seeds

comparison_identifiability.executed_objects: A joint-20D centralized actor and a neighbour-endpoint 10D shared edge actor control the same three edge-flow coordinates, feasible set, actuator path, timing, training budget, seed budget, critic form, reward, and fresh evaluation bank. Deployment information differs: joint versus endpoint-only.
comparison_identifiability.identified_estimand: The guarded performance contrast between these two frozen information-and-execution objects in the R292 scalar-common-plus-vector-residual formulation.
comparison_identifiability.allowed_claim: The neighbour-only distributed edge policy is superior, not separated, inferior, or lacks reproducible value relative to q0 and the matched joint-information centralized vector policy in this executed setup.
stay_out_claims: pure MARL architectural value independent of information access

stop_conditions: action, storage, physical, tail, or provenance guard failure
scientific_gate: A passing engineering recovery only reopens frozen formal execution; it does not validate a scientific claim until the full formal summary and round publication and close-out gates complete.
